dhp197:1: Oh, happily let us live! free from hatred, among those who hate;
dhp197:3: Among men who hate, let us live free from hatred.
dhp198:1: Oh, happily let us live! free from hatred, among those who hate;
dhp198:3: Among men who hate, let us live free from hatred.
dhp199:1: Oh, happily let us live! free from disease, among those who are afflicted with disease;
dhp199:3: Among men who are afflicted with disease, let us live free from disease.
dhp200:1: Oh, happily let us live! we who possess naught;
dhp200:3: Let us live on the food of joy, like the Bright Gods.
dhp201:1: Victory produces hatred; he that is defeated is afflicted with suffering;
dhp201:3: He that has renounced both victory and defeat lives in tranquillity and happiness.
dhp202:1: There is no fire like the fire of lust;
dhp202:2: There is no sin like the sin of hatred;
dhp202:3: There are no sufferings like the sufferings of existence;
dhp202:4: There is no happiness like Supreme Tranquillity.
dhp203:1: Hunger is the greatest of afflictions; the Aggregates of Being are the principal source of suffering;
dhp203:3: If a man thoroughly understand this, he has attained Nibbāna, Supreme Happiness.
dhp204:1: Health is the greatest acquisition, contentment is the greatest wealth,
dhp204:3: Confidence is the best of relatives, Nibbāna is the greatest happiness.
dhp205:1: He who has tasted the sweetness of solitude and the sweetness of tranquillity,
dhp205:3: Such a one is free from fear and free from sin, for he drinks the sweetness of the joy of the Law.
dhp206:1: It is a good thing to look upon the Noble, and to live with them is ever pleasant;
dhp206:3: It would be pleasant, might one never look upon a simpleton at all.
dhp207:1: For he who walks in the company of simpletons suffers a long time;
dhp207:4: Pleasant is it to live with the steadfast, even as is a meeting of kinsfolk.
dhp208:1: One should follow the steadfast, the wise, the learned, the patient, the dutiful, the Noble;
dhp208:4: One should follow so good and intelligent a man, as the moon follows the path of the stars.
